description: Double-sided letter from Claudia O'Keeffe to both Anita O'Keeffe Young and Georgia O'Keeffe. The envelope is addressed to Anita Young in Georgia O'Keeffe's handwriting. The first page of the letter has a note by Claudia: "Georgia, I thought it best to send this to Anita via you."
title: Claudia O'Keeffe to Anita O'Keeffe Young and Georgia O'Keeffe
